title: ToEndAllWars
description:
Modpack for the TEAW v4 Earth server!

Will you participate in the war to end all wars?
body:
ToEndAllWars is a modded, Earth-based factions server set in the 1800s. This is the modpack for that server. 

If you like building machines, industrializing, making weapons of mass destruction, building, or war, you'll enjoy TEAW!

This modpack adds:
* Content/automation mods such as Create, Farmers Delight, Villager Recruits, Exposure
* Transportation mods such as Simple Planes
* QOL Mods like Chat Heads, Controlling, FancyMenu
* And more!

To join the server, just click the "ToEndAllWars" button on the main menu!

_Will you participate in the war to end all wars?_
